scope: Meta FY2021–FY2025 Other financing activities, retained SEC annual filings plus official earnings calls and follow-up Q&A
bottom_line: Public primary disclosures contain contextual commentary and an exact FY2021 overdraft presentation reconciliation. The reviewed disclosures do not provide a dollar-linked decomposition of residual Other financing for FY2021–FY2025. This is a bounded search result, not a claim that no explanation exists anywhere or that the residual is debt.

findings.fact: Original statement separately reports a net change in overdraft in cash pooling entities of +14M and Other financing activities of -13M. Later comparative statements report Other+1M. Notes explain that a third-party bank provides overdraft credit inside a notional cash pool.
findings.preferred_treatment: Preserve the source-supported +14M as borrowing once; preserve -13M residual as unresolved; do not add later Other+1M again.
findings.remaining_gap: No decomposition of the original -13M residual.

findings.fact: Finance-lease financing cash flows of 2,524M are separately disclosed in the lease note and the statement. Long-term debt proceeds net29,906M are also a separate statement line.
findings.preferred_treatment: Include these identified financing components once. Do not use either amount to explain residual Other2,220M without additional source linkage.
findings.remaining_gap: Residual Other2,220M remains unclassified; do not infer that finance-lease principal is missing.

findings.fact: Annual statement separately places the Venture distribution2,554M in investing. Q3 CFO commentary states future20% share of joint-venture construction costs will be recorded as other investing cash flows.
findings.preferred_treatment: Keep these source classifications outside debt proceeds; do not attribute the Venture receipt to Other financing just because its size is similar.

findings.fact: Management discusses flexible ownership structures, third-party capital, and potential future prudent external financing.
findings.preferred_treatment: Use as financing-policy context only; narrative does not identify any exact historical Other component.

findings.fact: Reviewed annual financing MD&A, full statement, debt/lease/cash-policy/acquisition/equity notes, and keyword/financial-section review of the listed official transcripts. No residual Other component was bound to a disclosed cash amount.
findings.preferred_treatment: Maintain amount and unresolved classification visibly. Do not treat the whole line as borrowing, as zero, or as a closed/reconciled item.
findings.next_source_step: A specific issuer IR clarification or additional source disclosure linking cash amounts to the statement line is needed to classify the residual; no external message has been sent.

scope_limits: No assertion that every public earnings call from2021–2025 was reviewed. Selected annual/full-year calls plus the2025Q3 transaction discussion and follow-up calls were reviewed.
Only exact source-bound facts can become calculation operands. Generic management commentary is insufficient.
Q42021 call was not retained or reviewed; annual2021financial statements and notes were reviewed.
No residual monetary value was reverse-engineered from balance-sheet differences.
Research identifies classification scope; it does not independently approve changes to tax, investment, stock-compensation or ownership conventions.
